narrative.details:
Finally, you are of age, adventurer... of age to battle in the name of the Horde. To conquer for the glory of the Warchief.

Yes...

<Kaltunk looks you over.>

You will do nicely.

No doubt you wish to find a great dragon or demon and strangle it with your bare hands, but perhaps it would be wise to start on something less... dangerous.

<Kaltunk laughs.>

Report to Gornek, he should be able to assign a task better suited to a young champion. You will find Gornek in the Den, to the west.
narrative.objectives: Speak with Gornek. You recall Kaltunk marking your map with his location and mentioning that Gornek resided in the Den, a building to the west.
narrative.offerRewardText: Another one of Kaltunk's recruits, hm?A sorry state of affairs we find ourselves in if this is the best the Horde can produce. No matter. By the time we think you're ready to leave the Valley, you'll be a proud champion of the Horde.
narrative.requestItemsText: The carapace of a scorpid isn't so thick that the strength of a determined champion will be deterred. Strike strongly and without doubt, and the scorpids should prove easy prey.

chain.subtitle: 15 quests from level 1 to 3, 880 XP in all.

quests.objectiveText: Kill 10 Mottled Boars then return to Gornek at the Den.

quests.objectiveText: Warrior, Warrior, Hunter, Rogue, Shaman, Priest, Mage, Hunter, Rogue, Shaman, Warlock
